changelog: A slow upload no longer costs the gateway its cloud connection. Uploads were cut off after 4 seconds on a slow link, and each cut forced a new secure connection until the gateway ran out of memory for one and stopped reaching Firebase until its power was cut
A failed secure connection now waits before the next try instead of retrying at once, which was making the memory problem worse
The status light and the app no longer show a healthy cloud while every upload is failing
